annotations.title: Post a job or shift free (needs the employer's email confirmation)

description: Job Spotter. Post a job or shift free (needs the employer's email confirmation). For small employers: posts a job or a single shift free. It goes live after the employer presses a link emailed to their work address (personal addresses get a quick check first), shows in Job Spotter's search, on its own page that Google for Jobs can list, and in alerts. Jobs close after 30 days, shifts when they end.

apply_email.description: Or an email to apply to.

email.description: The employer's work email; a confirmation link goes there.

pay_per.description: Pay per: year, hour, day or month.

shift_end.description: Shift end, ISO date and time.

shift_start.description: Shift start, ISO date and time.

type.description: Type: full_time, part_time, contract, temporary, internship or per_diem.
